svg.title: Figure S2b-E: F(k) - F(final) of every relaxation read by E

cc:Work.dc:title: Figure S2b-E: F(k) - F(final) of every relaxation read by E
cc:Work.dc:description:
S2 K3: fail (fail_replan); checks_failed: s2r_m30_VB76, check 5 (C2_RESULT.md). S2b FR: pass. Valid far references: 1 of 2.
Figure S2b-E. F(k) − F(final) of every relaxation that E read in the deferred hinge run (E_hinge_output.txt, attempt 1, HEAD 00bb6616bc9d95f0ea0a45be844d65ebef026d10), against the configuration k counted across restart parts (S2B_PLAN.md §7, "The figure"). a, C2 relaxations 1–4 (block 5, hinge): m30 Pb136, Sr. Each curve is F(k) − F(final) in meV of the configurations that E parsed with scripts/47 parse_relax (read = full) at 8bff03e, as E printed it; F(final) is F at the record's k_last. The y axis is symmetric-logarithmic and linear within ±0.1 meV (grey band). Colour shows the quartet and line style the cell (host_R, V⁺_R as V, D, D+V⁺ as D+V; legend: E's order, cell, label). Ticks mark the first configuration of each restart part. Each light lane spans a ΔF_tail window [k_last − 36, k_last], in the legend's order, and the open diamond marks F(k_last − 36) − F(final) on its curve; ΔF_tail: path energy of the whole region over the window; not attributable to the failing objects; bounds no E_b error; reported only. End glyphs show each record's end rule (accepted: converged or plateau; unconverged: cap or early end), as D-C2-11. Every curve is one deterministic relaxation: there are no replicates and no intervals. Source data: figures/source_data/fig_s2b_e_fk_hinge.csv and fig_s2b_e_fk_hinge_meta.csv, written by E (OP-24).
